During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained a '''communications tower''' on the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Iceberg Three]] in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]. When the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]] and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] used the communications tower to warn the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of the impending invasion of the system.
